Operational Times Operational Times

RISE & DINE WITH BURGER KING®!

We've got big news, flame-grilled fans!
Burger King® is now open from 07:00am!

That's right, we're officially serving up BK® Breakfast,
from 07:00am to 11:00am.

Start your day with Burger King®'s new breakfast offer, featuring Brekkie Burgers and English Muffins. But that's not all; along with breakfast, we have a limited menu available, so you don't have to miss out on your BK® favourites. Breakfast and limited menu, 07:00am – 10:00am.

From 10:00am, you can enjoy both breakfast and our full menu. Then, from 11:00 am until closing, it's back to the complete BK® feast you know and love, ready to satisfy your hunger.

This exciting change is happening at every single Burger King® restaurant nationwide, ensuring that all our guests can enjoy our new breakfast hours. Please note that closing times may vary. Be sure to check BK® Finder or contact your local restaurant for the latest closing times.

Your mornings just got a whole lot tastier. Rest assured, we're following all necessary safety measures.

See you bright and early!


"Morning made easy – Enjoy the BK® brekkie with a limited menu of your faves from 7:00 am - 10:00 am. The full menu joins the party at 10:00 am."

"From 11:00am 'til close, it's all about the full BK® menu – breakfast bows out."

"Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi while you tuck into your BK® favourites."

Halaal Certification Halaal Certification

Due to guest demand, in 2016, BURGER KING® SA conducted an extensive project to quantify the guest demand for a non-Halaal product.

Due to the positive research results, BURGER KING® SA began a consultative process with our Halaal certifying body SHURA, regarding the introduction of a non-Halaal product.

In addition to working with SHURA, BURGER KING® also commissioned a research programme in 2019 to determine which BURGER KING® restaurants should remain Halaal-certified.

The process followed by BURGER KING® and SHURA has been transparent and respectful to ensure no or minimal inconvenience, disruption or offence to BURGER KING®'s existing Muslim guests.


(61) BURGER KING® restaurants remain Halaal certified - no change.

(92) BURGER KING® restaurants now operate without Halaal certification, due to the introduction of non-Halaal products.

The BURGER KING® Supply Chain and Logistics system and all other products remain Halaal.

Drink Options & Refills Drink Options & Refills

Your Choice, Your Way!

All BK® meals are advertised with a sugar-free drink included in the price. Should you prefer a regular (sugary) drink, an additional charge of R3 will apply.

Sip, Refill, Repeat!

When you dine in with us, you can enjoy free refills on our fountain drinks for up to 1 hour after your purchase. Refills are only available on the drinks we serve in-restaurant and for sit-down guests. Just hang onto your proof of purchase and top up as you please!
